name: Bridal Sedan Chair
description: The bridal sedan, also known as the wedding sedan, has an exquisite shape and gorgeous decoration. It is often paved with vermilion lacquer and decorated with gold foil. The whole body is engraved with exquisite patterns, which is magnificent and luxurious. The body of the sedan chair is often decorated with a sedan coat made of red silk and satin, embroidered with festive patterns such as a happy marriage for a hundred years, dragons and phoenixes, symbolizing sweet love and a happy life. The sedan chair is a Chinese wedding culture that has been passed down for thousands of years, and a woman can only sit in it once in her life. Getting married in a sedan chair is the happiest and most beautiful moment in a woman's life.
